description: One successful ping/pong round trip, then the peer stops answering and the keepalive watchdog fires. OVERVIEW.md section 2.9 Keepalive: ping_interval 30000ms, ping_timeout 90000ms, measured from last_pong_received. The watchdog fires once elapsed time since last_pong_received strictly exceeds ping_timeout (elapsed > ping_timeout, not >=), i.e. at 90001ms of silence, not 90000ms.
